title: Cross-Centaur: Modeling Individual Decision-Making Across Psychological Tasks with Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.23157v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as computational models of human behavior. Recent models such as Centaur have advanced this goal by fine-tuning LLMs on trial-by-trial decisions from psychological experiments. However, existing large-scale behavioral datasets do not link the same participants across different tasks, so these models learn population-level regularities but are not trained to model individual-level regularities across tasks. We introduce Cross-Psych-101, a dataset of 591 participants and 261{,}551 valid decisions across 12 Bandit, Tradeoff, Structure, and Social tasks. We train Cross-Centaur to predict a participant's target-task actions from a target-task description and the source-task description paired with the same participant's source-task behavior. translated_title: Cross-Centaur：基于语言模型对跨心理学任务的个体决策建模
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）正日益被用作人类行为的计算模型。诸如Centaur等近期模型通过在心理学实验的逐试次决策数据上微调大语言模型，推进了这一目标。然而，现有的大规模行为数据集并未将同一参与者在不同任务中的数据关联起来，因此这些模型学到的是群体层面的规律，而未被训练去建模跨任务的个体层面规律。我们提出了Cross-Psych-101数据集，涵盖591名参与者在12个Bandit（赌博机）、Tradeoff（权衡）、Structure（结构）和Social（社交）任务中的261,551个有效决策。我们训练了Cross-Centaur，使其根据目标任务描述、以及与同一参与者的源任务行为相配对的源任务描述，来预测该参与者在目标任务中的行为。在留出的参与者上，Cross-Centaur无论在任务内还是跨任务场景下均优于现成的大语言模型和Centaur。探测分析表明其隐藏（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出包含591名参与者跨12个心理学任务关联行为数据的Cross-Psych-101数据集，并训练Cross-Centaur模型，首次建模跨任务的个体层面决策规律，在任务内与跨任务预测上均超越现成大语言模型和Centaur。
en_tdlr: We introduce Cross-Psych-101, a dataset linking the same participants' behaviors across 12 psychological tasks, and train Cross-Centaur to model individual-level decision-making across tasks, outperforming off-the-shelf LLMs and Centaur on held-out participants both within and across tasks.
